name: Aizawa Masato
source:
A kind and gentle person who lacks sense of authority and tends to be reserved with the other party.

During his college days, he hosted a game production circle. After graduation he got a job at a major game company. Shortly after, he married his first love.

Because her wife doesn't have a sense of frugality, he decided to put some of his salary in a separate bank account for their future, leading her wife to look for work.

When he found some erotic pictures on the net of a person that resembled his wife, he started being suspicious of her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hendingerg.com/products/kasen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
